==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My memory is very hazy. I barely remember what happened. I mainly recall something about magical pets and an app.

The app was some kind of AI application. I think it was related to the magical pets in some way. Maybe the pets were virtual pets created by the app?

I think the pets resembled weird hybrids. For example I remember a dog shark surrounded by pink sparkles. Sadly I don't remember much more than that.
